pokedexEntries.ru: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

pokedexEntries.sa: ALTARIA sings in a gorgeous soprano. Its wings are like cotton clouds. This POKéMON catches updrafts with its buoyant wings and soars way up into the wild blue yonder.

pokedexEntries.frlg: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.

pokedexEntries.em: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.dp: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

pokedexEntries.pt: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

pokedexEntries.bw: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
